formats.name: Lo-Fi "POV" Day-in-the-Life Vlogs
formats.desc: Raw, hand-held, ambient-audio video logs revealing unedited daily routines.

formats.name: GRWM (Get Ready With Me)
formats.desc: Conversational storytelling while applying makeup, styling outfits, or preparing for an event.

formats.name: Aesthetic "Dump" & Photo Slideshows
formats.desc: Multi-photo carousels blending candid photos, memes, receipts, and low-exposure snapshots.

formats.name: ASMR Unboxing & Tactile Reviews
formats.desc: Sensory-heavy videos focusing on crisp audio (swatching, packaging taps, product pops).

formats.name: Micro-Tutorials & 60-Second "Life Hacks"
formats.desc: Ultra-fast educational videos explaining practical adulting, career, or tech hacks.

formats.name: Meme-Format Video Reactions
formats.desc: Pairing viral soundbites or trending video templates with relatable, self-deprecating text overlays.

formats.name: "Outfit of the Day" (OOTD) & Thrift Hauls
formats.desc: Fast-paced outfit breakdowns highlighting secondhand scores and micro-aesthetic styling.

formats.name: Product "Dupe" Side-by-Side Comparisons
formats.desc: Honest lab-style testing comparing high-end items against budget alternatives.

formats.name: "De-Influencing" & Brutally Honest Audits
formats.desc: Videos explicitly telling followers what *not* to buy, building high trust through negative reviews.

formats.name: Silent Reviews & Gestural Ratings
formats.desc: Expressing opinions solely through facial expressions, thumbs up/down, and rating cards without speaking.

formats.name: Polls & Interactive Story Stickers
formats.desc: Low-friction tap-to-vote stickers embedded in Instagram/TikTok stories.

formats.name: Duets & Remix / Reaction Clips
formats.desc: Side-by-side video responses building on another creator’s original content.

formats.name: User-Generated Challenge Hashtags
formats.desc: Interactive challenges encouraging audience co-creation around a specific audio or physical gesture.

formats.name: Live Stream Shopping & Q&A Drops
formats.desc: Real-time video broadcasts with clickable buy-buttons and instant host replies.

formats.name: Interactive Quizzes & Diagnostic Engines
formats.desc: Bite-sized personality tests or shade-matchers revealing customized recommendations.

formats.name: Crowdsourced Comment Section Q&As
formats.desc: Content explicitly driven by screenshotting and answering top audience comments.

formats.name: Augmented Reality (AR) Try-On Filters
formats.desc: Virtual makeup, hair dye, or sneaker overlays used inside camera apps.

formats.name: Ephemereal "Photodump" Stories
formats.desc: 24-hour expiring raw photo dumps signaling casual immediacy rather than permanent feed polish.

formats.name: Discord Community Voice & Stage Discussions
formats.desc: Live, informal audio lounge sessions hosted within interest-based servers.

formats.name: Gamified Roblox / Virtual World Quests
formats.desc: In-game branded mini-games offering exclusive virtual cosmetics (UGC items).
